owner: Dr Steven You, Dr Ryan Chou and the team
summary: Chatswood since 2014 with implants and Invisalign is a strength, but conflicting phone numbers and a booking form with defects appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The About section appears to give (02) 8074 3849 while the header and footer show (02) 8599 1999, and the Call Us Now button appears to use (02) 80743849.
findings.cost: Three numbers for one clinic cause missed calls.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to show a Preferred Date label with no date field, garbled options such as 'Your Interest Your InterestGeneral Dentistry', and the form repeats twice.
findings.cost: A broken form loses patients who try to book online.

findings.problem: The Invisalign heading appears above cosmetic copy ('Everyone wants to appear younger'), the Dr Steven You bio appears to say 'Dr. Chou speaks fluent English', and 'All-on-6 Dental lmplants' appears with a lowercase L.
findings.cost: Wrong copy and typos weaken a clinical brand.

findings.problem: The page says 'Check out our opening hours below' but no hours appear, three blog articles appear to share the same All-on-6 summary, and the free implant offer says 'Limited time only' with no end date.
findings.cost: Missing hours, copied summaries and an undated offer lose trust and urgency.
findings.fix: Visible hours, unique summaries and a dated offer.

redesign: One verified number and a clean booking form.
Correct service copy, bios and visible hours.
Unique blog summaries and a dated offer.
